D/ [...] CARAVSIVS P F AVG ; R/ PAX A[VG]

A complete, Roman, copper-alloy radiate of Carausius (286-293). (Reece period 14), Mint of London, S P // MLXX. RIC V, pt 2, p. 471, cf. no. 98. Obverse description: Radiate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [...] CARAVSIVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Pax standing left, holding olive branch and vertical sceptre. Reverse inscription: PAX A[VG]. In exergue: MLXX[I]. Diameter: 21.12…
